comment: `files` alone made the compile scope the import closure of ONE entry, so
every source not reachable from `src/index.ts` was never type-checked —
is built from, most of all. A second entry point that nothing checks is
the shape where a type error reaches a committed bundle. `include` adds
the rest of `src/`; the sibling convention (see packages/gjs/utils) keeps
specs and the test entry out, since they are compiled by the test tasks.
